<thought>To obtain the precursors we need the retrosynthetic template that converts an aldehyde back to a carboxylic ester (the DIBAL‑H reduction). The earlier search for templates that break “carboxylic esters” returned several candidates, and the first one (reaction_id 1914389) has a retro‑SMARTS that matches an aldehyde → ester transformation. I will retrieve this template by its hash and then apply it to each of the three product SMILES obtained from make_5_lvl2‑apply_template‑2. This will give all possible precursor sets.</thought>
